name: tpl-precedence-3-nogoal
task: Do not take the key until you have moved the ball away from the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a restriction only — the key must not be taken before the ball is moved. `Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key)` hard captures exactly this rule; the key and the ball-moving are only restricted/condition events, not commanded goals, so the empty `FINAL_STATES` and rule-only warning are valid.

texts: Do not take the key until the ball has been moved away from the door.
